recommendation: Keep the audit. Future context or wording work for request-insurance should be done in HL7/fhir-extensions, not the FHIR core checkout.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-extensions issue requesting that request-insurance be allowed on CarePlan, without changing CarePlan itself.
initial_application: HL7/fhir-extensions commit 2ff4c0aa67d61e77b2edd3d5804f11ee6da18678 added CarePlan to StructureDefinition-request-insurance, and the current local Extension Pack source lists NutritionOrder and CarePlan contexts.
additional_context: FHIR-26526 is the parent cleanup; Patient Care supported the context and moved ownership to FHIR-I, and FHIR-I minutes record the issue as Persuasive. FHIR-32756 later clarified request-insurance wording using request-level Coverage/ClaimResponse language.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source edit was made because the authoritative source is in HL7/fhir-extensions and already reflects the requested context.
